svg.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: a third guidance source, built on the Historian (Sub-model 14) — trend-based, not real-time or procedural
same field as Sub-model 12, no new schema — procedural | simulated | now also predictive
one Operator Guidance Panel (Sub-model 12) still shows all three — the source label tells the operator which kind of claim it is
PredictedEvent — Joins the Alarm System, Doesn't Sit Beside It
one situational-awareness picture (Sub-model 13) — not a second screen the operator has to remember to check
predictive maintenance (internal-pattern): bearing wear predicted in 3–6 weeks → Priority 2 alarm, tagged predictive
predictive analytics (external-forecast): solar output predicted to drop for 4 hours → same Alarm mechanism, same screen, different basisType
predictive maintenance is one case of the broader predictive analytics category — basisType keeps both first-class, not a second mechanism for the external case
not a policy choice like Sub-model 12/14 — a fixed rule, with no false-case, by design
no shortcut from step 2 to step 4 — not even at confidence = 1.0
contrast with Sub-model 12: a Scenario can be shown to an operator directly; an
ImprovementRecommendation changes how the plant runs — a materially bigger decision
the Historian finds the pattern and the AI drafts the suggestion — neither one ever touches the configuration
